narrative.data_gaps_md:
Confidence distribution across 709 capability: HIGH = 199 (28.1%), MEDIUM = 482 (68.0%), LOW = 28 (3.9%). The assessment operates in PUBLIC evidence mode with RESEARCH_HANDOFF, meaning all evidence is externally sourced — no internal client documents, Hubbl scans, or discovery notes were available.
Key data gaps that would improve assessment precision with internal evidence: (1) Internal technology roadmap or digital strategy documents would lift confidence from MEDIUM to HIGH and potentially increase score. (2) Hubbl/BuiltWith scan of Salesforce org would provide T1 verification of SF configuration, utilization metrics, and custom object inventory — potentially lifting and scores. (3) Discovery session notes on data warehouse architecture would clarify / capability — current scoring relies on absence of public signals which may understate actual capability. (4) Employee engagement survey results would provide T2 evidence for beyond Indeed's external ratings. (5) BCP/DR test results would address gap — current score assumes absence due to no public evidence.
capability scored LOW confidence (28 total) are concentrated in ESG (no evidence of any kind) and Analytics (evidence confirms absence rather than presence). These LOW-confidence scores are conservative — internal evidence could raise or confirm them.
